description: United States: MLS data via the RESO Web API, county parcel numbers, appraisal rules from the lender's guidelines (USPAP applies to appraisers).

parcel.note: Parcel numbers (APN) differ by county. Replace the pattern per county in `parcel_overrides`.

onboarding: Apply to the MLS (or the MLS-aggregator) as a data licensee: the intended use is automated valuation
Sign the data licence: record permitted uses, display rules, attribution text, redistribution, retention and audit rights
Obtain RESO Web API credentials (OAuth client credentials or a bearer token) and the replication limits
Confirm whether closed (sold) data may be used for model training, and for how long it may be stored
Name the MLS compliance contact; agree how audits and takedown requests work
licence.attribution: Listing data courtesy of the local MLS. Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed.
